# libusb

Release builds link statically against [libusb](https://libusb.info) 1.0.30, licensed under
LGPL-2.1-or-later (see `COPYING`). Its source is not stored in this repository. Every release
has the exact tarball attached:

    https://github.com/libusb/libusb/releases/download/v1.0.30/libusb-1.0.30.tar.bz2
    SHA-256: fea36f34f9156400209595e300840767ab1a385ede1dc7ee893015aea9c6dbaf
